inputs.text: Phoenix leaders are calling Wednesday night’s vote “oversight,” but it sounds more like cover for controlling where federal immigration enforcement can operate and what the public can see. The restrictions put city officials in charge of setting the rules and managing the story. The accountability argument seems part of the maneuver, not a reason to take their explanation at face value.
